name: aiya-chat-team
description: Chat quality team plugin for AIYA shop owners: a 3 position team (chat_head, chat_responder, chat_followup) matching the AIYA chat team itself, an 11-skill playbook (answer from knowledge, brand voice, handoff to human, triage urgency, price and stock reply, buying signal to sales, daily room digest, apology and remedy, edit bot reply, edit bot persona, setup auto reply), draft-first workflows where every drafted reply waits for a human to click send, plus auto-reply flows that let the bot answer real customers on its own only after the shop owner confirms turning each flow on
